chunks: They will hear no frivolity there, nor false speech.
ai.seo_question: What kind of speech do the inhabitants of Paradise hear?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mursalat is often interpreted as a comprehensive negation of all minor and major defects in speech, ensuring that the inhabitants of Jannah are shielded from both trivial idle talk and significant falsehood. This purity of discourse reflects the inner spiritual state of the believers, where their tongues are purified to align with divine truth, a concept deeply connected to the idea of 'Ismah (infallibility) in the highest ranks of Paradise.
